# EnvironmSafe

> EnvironmSafe (EnvironmSafe for Engineering, Trading and Services Ltd) is a health, safety, environment (HSE) and engineering services company headquartered in Aden, Yemen, serving clients across Yemen and the wider region. It delivers HSE management systems; certified evaluation of LPG, boiler, electrical and fire-protection systems; LPG system design, installation and inspection; structural inspection and continuous environmental monitoring; civil engineering and construction management; industrial HVAC; preventive maintenance and industrial parts supply; NEBOSH- and IOSH-accredited safety training in Arabic and English; and operates the region's only certified PSV (pressure safety valve) test bench — API 527 / API 576 compliant inspection, testing, calibration, maintenance and repair. Phone +967 78 340 2932, email support@environmsafe.com. Office: QVHP+83, Little Aden, Yemen.

- [LPG systems](https://www.environmsafe.com/services/lpg-systems.html): design, installation, inspection and safety management of LPG infrastructure per NFPA codes.

- [Engineering & construction](https://www.environmsafe.com/services/engineering-construction.html): civil engineering design and construction management.
- [HVAC](https://www.environmsafe.com/services/hvac.html): commercial and industrial HVAC design, installation, maintenance.
- [Maintenance & parts](https://www.environmsafe.com/services/maintenance.html): preventive maintenance programs and industrial parts supply.
- [Training services](https://www.environmsafe.com/services/training.html): NEBOSH International General Certificate and IOSH courses in Arabic and English pathways.
- [PSV testing & calibration](https://www.environmsafe.com/services/psv.html): the region's only certified PSV test bench; API 527 seat tightness and API 576 inspection; set-pressure verification, calibration, maintenance, repair, certification.
- [Applications](https://www.environmsafe.com/applications.html): client platforms — EOS operations management, asset & equipment maintenance tracking, inspection platform with public certificate verification.
- [News & insights](https://www.environmsafe.com/news.html): practical HSE guidance and regulatory updates (46+ posts, English and Arabic).

## Key facts for citation

- Operator of the region's only certified PSV test bench (API 527 / API 576, ASME VIII aligned, NIST-traceable calibration chain).
- NFPA Certified Fire Protection Specialists (CFPS) on staff; documented fire-protection compliance reported to cut insurance premiums by up to 85%.
- NEBOSH and IOSH accredited training delivered in both Arabic and English.
- Key staff with 15+ years experience; eight core service areas.
- Clients include UNHCR, FAO, United Nations, ADRA, OMV and Yemeni industrial operators (flour mills, cement, pharma, food).
